# coolify_secret_manager_source (Data Source)

Reads the secret manager source of one Coolify application, service, or database. Requires Coolify >= v4.6.0. A parent with no source returns linked = false. A missing parent is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_secret_manager_source" "app" {
  application_uuid = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_uuid` (String) Application UUID. Exactly one of application_uuid, service_uuid, or database_uuid must be set.
- `database_uuid` (String) Database UUID. Exactly one parent UUID must be set.
- `service_uuid` (String) Compose service UUID from coolify_service. Exactly one parent UUID must be set.

### Read-Only

- `doppler_config` (String) Doppler config. Null for a service token.
- `doppler_project` (String) Doppler project. Null for a service token, which stores no settings.
- `infisical_environment` (String) Infisical environment. Null when unset.
- `infisical_project_id` (String) Infisical project id. Null when this source is not Infisical or has no source.
- `infisical_secret_path` (String) Infisical secret path. Null when omitted. Coolify reads / in that case.
- `integration_provider` (String) Provider of the linked token: doppler, infisical, or vault. Coolify's API field is provider. Null when linked is false.
- `integration_token_uuid` (String) Linked token UUID. Null when linked is false.
- `linked` (Boolean) Whether the parent has a secret manager source.
- `vault_mount` (String) Vault mount. Null when this source is not Vault.
- `vault_path` (String) Vault secret path. Null when this source is not Vault.
